{{Quote|He set things right in Tuskens’ Escape.|Emala on Han Solo|<ref name="Ghost" />}}
'''Tuskens' Escape''' was a maze-like network of deep-cut alleys branching off [[Arch Canyon]] in [[Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The area was characterized by multiple interweaving forks that split repeatedly, forming a braided labyrinth that made pursuit and navigation difficult.
